p.i: genus, quo duæ scaphæ, pari commensu sibi respondentes, ita compingebantur, ut hominis corpus illis inditum, quasi in vagina esset, cui præbebatur mel temperatum cum lacte, ac invito etiam infundebantur in os, unde viveret, &c.

main_text.p: צנור masc. Emissarium, Canalis, Tubus; per quem aqua emittuntur, 2.Sam.5.8. Plur. צנוריך [?] Canalium tuorum, Psal.42.8.
צנתרות [?] m.pl. Tubi, Fistulæ, Zachar.4.12. Aben Esra scribit, esse vas, in quo calcantur olivæ.

צעד Gradi, Progredi, Procedere, Itare: Præter: צעדו [?] Progressi essent, 2.Sam.6.13. צעד Procedit, Genes.49.22. Infinitiv. בצעדך [?] Quum gradereris tu, Judic.5.4. Futurum, יצעד Gradiebatur, Proverb.7.8. Hiph. Futur. ותצעידהו [?] Et incedere facit vel adigit eum, Job.18.14.

צער [?] m. Gressus, Passus, Processus: Proverb.30.29. Aff.: את־צעדו [?] Gressum suum, Jesa.10.23. Plur. צעדים Gressus, 2.Sam.6.13. Constr. צעדי אונו [?] Gressus roboris ejus, Job.18.v.7. Aff. צעדי [?] Gressus meos, Job.14.16.
צעדדי [?] f. Incessus, 2.Sam.5.24. Pluraliter, Perisceles, Jesa.3.20. juxta R.Salomonem & Chaldæum: juxta Aben Esram, Armillæ.
אצעדה [?] fœm. Periscelis: Armilla, Numer.31.50. 1.Samuel.i.10. ubi expressè dicitur brachiorum ornamentum esse.
מצעדים [?] m.p. Gressus: Constr. מצעדי גבר [?] Gressus viri, Psalm.37.23.
צעה Peragravit, Peregrinatus est, Peregrè egit: Partic. צעה Peregrinans, exulans seu vagans, Jes.51.14. Fœm. צעה Peregras, Jer.2.20. Pih. Præteritum וצעהו [?] Et peregrè agant eum, Jer.48.12.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew forms are read from a small, dense scan and are doubtful; they are marked [?]. The Samuel reference "i.10" and the Hebrew plural forms in the צעד and צער entries are uncertain. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
